contracts.description: A run of interface text. Note text is never rendered with this; it lives in block components.
An interface heading for a sheet, dialog, or section.
A Fluent UI System icon. Decorative unless it has a label.
A labelled action. Its label says what it does.
An icon-only action with a required label, shown as its tooltip and accessible name.
Shows a control's name and shortcut. Never holds information you can't get another way.
The red dot. Its tone signals a save problem on the trigger.
The frosted circle with the red dot. The Trigger compound places it and gives it behavior.
Children in a column, spaced by a space token.
Children in a row, spaced by a space token.
A background, border, radius, and shadow. Frost works only inside a floating Layer.
Places content on a layer (trigger, panel, dialog, toast, tooltip) at a fixed position.
Centers content up to a maximum width, with the page gutter.
The root of every app view. Applies the theme and the token modes to the document.
The writing surface (Tiptap and ProseMirror). It owns the note's DOM; views place it once.
The trigger at the top center. Opens the toolbar, and shows a save problem in its dot.
